offers_products.reason: Water is delivered as regulated utility service; no manufactured goods or software are main offerings.

offers_services.reason: Regulated water and wastewater utility service, plus contract operation and maintenance of municipal and private systems.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Retail water and wastewater service to residential households in New Jersey and Delaware.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Serves commercial, industrial and municipal customers, wholesale water buyers, and contract operations for municipalities and developers.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing metered water and wastewater utility billing to residential and commercial customers, plus multi-year contract operations.

cyclical_demand.reason: Water and wastewater service is essential and regulated; customers cannot readily postpone or cut it in a downturn.

big_ticket.reason: Customers pay small, frequent water and sewer bills.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from the water treatment and distribution network and its assets, not mainly from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are residential and commercial ratepayers; municipal contracts are secondary.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and must keep investing in water treatment plants, distribution mains and wastewater systems, like any regulated utility.
